coverageRules: A source page is not proof that every grade/subject textbook exists.

Each individual resource must have its own title, grade, subject, language, resource type, publisher/owner, canonical source URL, version, publication date when available, rights status, checksum, last-checked timestamp and retrieval status.
Use DBE National Catalogue entries to identify approved commercial titles where a state-owned digital book is not listed.
Do not label a grade/subject pair complete until an authoritative CAPS document and an eligible resource have both been mapped.
Do not mirror or redistribute a resource until its specific licence or DBE permission permits that use.
